zones.name: citySAVER
zones.coverage: Brighton & Hove urban area — Old Shoreham/Red Lion (W) along the coast to Saltdean/Bannings Vale (E), bounded north by the A27/Downs through Tongdean Lane, Patcham (Black Lion), Old Boat Corner and Falmer.

zones.name: networkSAVER
zones.coverage: Valid on the entire Brighton & Hove network including night buses — far beyond citySAVER: east to Newhaven, Seaford & Eastbourne, north to Lewes, Uckfield & Tunbridge Wells, west to Steyning.

zones.name: Worthing Dayrider
zones.coverage: Worthing built-up area: Ferring/Goring west to The Longshore; arc north through Findon Valley with a spike up to Findon Homewood.

zones.name: Brighton Dayrider
zones.coverage: Where 9, 17 & 700 run: coast from The Longshore through Shoreham, Southwick, Portslade & Hove to Brighton centre, plus the 17 arm up to Black Lion.

zones.name: Metrovoyager
zones.coverage: Unlimited travel on Metrobus services (except TfL); also valid on Brighton & Hove Buses. Locally it covers the Brighton citySAVER area plus the route-23 corridor that runs south from Horsham via Findon into Worthing; tags show how far key Metrobus & B&H routes reach beyond Adur & Worthing.
zones.restrictions: Not valid on Transport for London (TfL) services.

zones.name: Gold Dayrider
zones.subgroup: Gold tickets — all Stagecoach buses in the area
zones.coverage: All day on every Stagecoach bus across Surrey, Hampshire & West Sussex — the whole network.

zones.name: Gold Nightrider
zones.subgroup: Gold tickets — all Stagecoach buses in the area
zones.coverage: Same network-wide validity as Gold Dayrider.
zones.restrictions: After 19:30 only; cheaper than the Dayrider.

fares.note: Same coverage as the Gold DayRider, valid from 19:30.

operator_notes.SCSO: N700 needs a £2 supplement on any Day/Night Rider, or £5 single.

fares_meta.basis_note: Based on a five-day commute, buying a day ticket each day.

unified_ticket.name: South Downs Discovery Ticket
unified_ticket.basis: An all-operator day ticket valid across West Sussex, East Sussex and Brighton & Hove. Not valid on the N700 or N1 night services. Priced as a day-out rover rather than a local commuter fare, which is the point: it is the only ticket that crosses operators, and it costs more than the local day tickets it replaces.

N700.label: N700 night-bus add-on
N700.note: £2 add-on to any Stagecoach Day/Night Rider; a single is £5.

fares_meta.supplement_basis: Night-service add-ons are counted once per journey.

reforms.headline: If the Worthing and Brighton DayRider zones were merged
reforms.detail: One DayRider covering both zones, at the £6 each already costs.

reforms.headline: If your ticket were valid on every operator on this route
reforms.detail: One day ticket, accepted on whichever operator's bus turns up.
